title: Finite basis coordinates for scalar extension of complexes
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a map of commutative ring sheaves on a small site, let $U$ be restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and choose $e:R^d\cong U(S)$ with $d\in\mathbf N$. For every cochain complex $P$ of $R$-module sheaves there is an isomorphism $\alpha:U(P\otimes_R S)\cong P^d$, using the termwise sheafified scalar extension [def-pur-change-of-rings-complex]. For every cochain degree $k$, site object $V$, section $s\in S(V)$, section $p\in P^k(V)$, and $i\in\{0,\ldots,d-1\}$, the $i$th coordinate of $\alpha^k$ on the sheafification image of $s\otimes p$ equals $\lambda_i(s)p$, where $\lambda_i$ is the $i$th coordinate of $e^{-1}$. This includes $d=0$.

proof.text: Evaluate the chosen basis isomorphism sectionwise. Tensor its inverse with M and use tensor commutativity and TensorProduct.piScalarRight to construct the inverse-coordinate module isomorphism. Naturality follows by induction on tensors, semilinearity of restrictions, and naturality of the basis coordinates.

Sheafify the presheaf isomorphism. Restriction commutes with sheafification: the canonical map has identity underlying abelian sheaf and is therefore an isomorphism. The sheafification adjunction unit and counit give the pure-tensor formula. Naturality in M follows from the tensor formula and adjunction naturality.

The module isomorphisms commute with differentials by naturality, and form an isomorphism of complexes to the degreewise product complex. Compose with the canonical finite-power complex isomorphism; its projection formula gives the required normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFreeScalarExtension (φ : R ⟶ S) (d : ℕ)
    (e : (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin d ↦ unit (𝓡 R)) ≅
      (restrictScalars (𝓻 φ)).obj (unit (𝓡 S)))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 R)) ℤ) :
    ∃ α : ((restrictScalars (𝓻 φ)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (changeOfRingsComplex.{u, u} φ P) ≅ ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin d ↦ P,
      ∀ (k : ℤ) (V : Cᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj V) (p : (P.X k).val.obj V) (i : Fin d),
        (((α.hom ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : Fin d ↦ P) i).f k).val.app V)
          ((toSheafify J (changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} φ (P.X k)).presheaf).app V
            (s ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V, (φ.hom.app V).hom] p)) =
          ((e.inv ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : Fin d ↦ unit (𝓡 R)) i).val.app V s) • p
